_meta.purpose: Editable watchlist for the weekly knowledge-refresh task. Each run, the task researches these sources, compares findings to the live agent/*.json knowledge base, and writes a proposed diff to agent/proposed-refresh.md. Nothing goes live until the owner approves. Edit this file to add/remove sources or watched fields.
